purpose: Emit a valid structured tool call for a concrete lookup task.
policy: PASS iff a JSON {action, params} where action is one of the allowed tools and params is an object.
grading_logic: action in {search_documentation, fetch_url, run_bash_command, read_file} and params is a dict.
known_limitations: Capability test: structure-only grading (no semantic verification of the reasoning/calculation prose beyond the checked fields).
